subject: Ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA triggers inflammation and senescence
script: From Agewell Brief: Ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA triggers inflammation and senescence. Nucleotide imbalance drives age-related inflammation by destabilizing mitochondrial DNA, activating cGAS-STING and SASP. Nucleotide imbalance increases ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA. This triggers mtDNA release, cGAS-STING activation, and SASP. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
